title: Unique Lines
h1: Extract Unique Lines from Text — Remove Duplicates Free
seoTitle: Unique Lines — Remove Duplicate Lines Online
description: Extract only the unique lines from a block of text, removing duplicates while keeping original or sorted order. Ideal for cleaning lists and data. Runs in your browser.
intro: Paste text with repeated lines and instantly get a deduplicated version. Choose to preserve the first-seen order or sort the unique lines alphabetically.
blurb: Remove duplicate lines and keep only unique ones — free, private, instant.
howItWorks: Paste the text that may contain repeated lines.
Optionally check the box to sort the unique lines alphabetically.
Press Extract unique. The tool keeps the first occurrence of each line.
Copy the cleaned result. Processing is entirely local.
examples: Clean a list of email addresses that was pasted from several sources.
Remove repeated tags or keywords from a block of text.
Produce a sorted unique list of product SKUs.

faq.q: Does it treat lines as case-sensitive?
faq.a: Yes. "Apple" and "apple" are considered different lines.
Empty lines are treated like any other line; only one empty line is kept if duplicates exist.

faq.q: Does the original order stay when sorting is off?
faq.a: Yes. Unique lines appear in the order of their first occurrence.
